title: Plan and Budget: Effective and Efficient Test-Time Scaling on Reasoning Large Language Models
authors_zh: Junhong Lin、Xinyue Zeng、Jie Zhu、Song Wang、Julian Shun、Jun Wu、Dawei Zhou
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算分配与推理轨迹评估研究
best_for_zh: 需要复现或审计子问题规划、token 分配、任务级 verifier 与测试时计算归因的研究者
one_line: Plan-and-Budget uses LLM-produced sub-question plans and credit-weighted schedules to vary test-time compute, with task-specific scoring and E3 aggregation but incomplete released run provenance.
Plan-and-Budget 用 LLM 生成子问题与 credits，并按调度规则分配测试时计算；其 E3 以任务分数和 token 成本汇总，但完整运行轨迹与来源元数据未发布。
why: It makes an allocation policy part of the reasoning record: credits and schedules can affect both output quality and token cost. The release is useful for method inspection and evaluation replication, but absent trace/result manifests and contamination evidence prevent treating it as an auditable training-data release.
inclusion_reason: This is a controlled-category test-time trace and scaling study because it attaches a plan, difficulty/credit allocation, budget schedule, final prediction, token usage, and task score to a reasoning episode, while exposing which of those records are actually released.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Plan-and-Budget studies a test-time-compute allocation problem, not a new post-training dataset: fixed token limits can reduce long reasoning but can also truncate hard problems. The ICLR 2026 paper models a query as sub-questions of unequal uncertainty, then evaluates whether planning plus local allocation changes task score and billed completion tokens (paper §§3–5).

For this atlas category, one potential episode is concrete: an upstream task item, an LLM-produced decomposition, difficulty/credit annotations, a scheduled budget, a target-model prediction, token-use fields, and a task score. The author repository distributes pre-decomposed evaluation inputs and code that can generate such results, but it does not supply an author-produced prompt-to-output result manifest. This is therefore an inference/evaluation recipe with partial trace availability, not evidence of a ready-to-train trace corpus.

The paper covers MATH-500, sampled NaturalInstructions, and TravelPlanner; it does not establish that these public benchmark inputs are safe training data or that its gains generalize outside those task/evaluator combinations. L4 evidence here is the final arXiv/OpenReview paper and linked author code, including preprocessing, inference, and evaluation files.

Plan-and-Budget 研究的是测试时计算分配，而不是一个新的后训练数据集：固定 token 上限可减少冗长推理，也可能截断困难问题。ICLR 2026 论文把一个查询表示为不确定性不同的子问题，并检验规划加局部分配是否改变任务分数与计费 completion tokens（论文第 3–5 节）。

对本图谱类别而言，一条潜在 episode 很具体：上游任务项、LLM 生成的分解、难度/credits 标注、调度后的预算、目标模型预测、token 使用字段和任务分数。作者仓库发布了预分解的评测输入和可生成这些结果的代码，但没有发布作者实际运行得到的 prompt-to-output 结果 manifest。因此它是一个轨迹可得性不完整的推理/评测 recipe，而不是可直接训练的轨迹语料证据。

论文覆盖 MATH-500、抽样的 NaturalInstructions 和 TravelPlanner；它没有证明这些公开 benchmark 输入适合作训练数据，也没有证明结果能推广到这些任务和 evaluator 之外。此处 L4 的证据边界是最终 arXiv/OpenReview 论文及其链接的作者代码，包括预处理、推理和评测文件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a training-free, model-agnostic test-time scaffold: Plan converts a query into ordered sub-questions with hints, and Budget uses their inferred difficulty/credits plus a schedule to tell the target model how much to reason on each part. The theoretical Budget Allocation Model (BAM; called BBAM in parts of the paper) motivates allocating more compute where uncertainty is higher; the implementation is a prompted allocation policy, not a learned verifier or reward model.

The feedback contract is mixed and task-level. MATH-500 uses parsed-answer checking with math_verify; NaturalInstructions uses ROUGE-L; TravelPlanner uses a secondary LLM to turn text into JSON before the TravelPlanner scorer. E3 = A^2 / T combines the resulting task score A and average billed completion tokens T. None of these signals tells the system whether an individual intermediate sub-question was correct; credits guide allocation but are not verified process labels.

The closest comparison surface is fixed global budgeting and planning-only baselines. Plan-and-Budget differs by making the allocation depend on sub-question credits and an optional decay schedule. It belongs in rollout/search/test-time trace data because the allocation metadata mediates between an input and a scored completion, even though raw author-run traces are not released.

其贡献是一个免训练、模型无关的测试时 scaffold：Plan 把查询变成带 hints 的有序子问题，Budget 则根据推断的难度/credits 与调度规则，提示目标模型在各部分投入多少推理。理论上的 Budget Allocation Model（论文部分位置称 BBAM）主张在不确定性较高处投入更多计算；具体实现是提示式分配策略，而不是学习得到的 verifier 或 reward model。

反馈契约是混合的、任务级的。MATH-500 以解析答案后的 math_verify 检查；NaturalInstructions 使用 ROUGE-L；TravelPlanner 先由第二个 LLM 将文本转为 JSON，再交给 TravelPlanner scorer。E3 = A^2 / T 把任务分数 A 与平均计费 completion tokens T 汇总。这些信号都不能说明某一中间子问题是否正确；credits 用于引导分配，但不是经过验证的过程标签。

最接近的比较对象是固定 global budget 和仅规划的 baseline。Plan-and-Budget 的差别在于其分配依赖子问题 credits 和可选的 decay schedule。它属于 rollout/search/test-time trace data，因为分配元数据介于输入与被评分的 completion 之间，尽管作者运行的原始轨迹未发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. The released code loads MATH-500, a local sampled NaturalInstructions JSON, and TravelPlanner validation items; TravelPlanner also carries reference information and requires a separately downloaded database. A preprocessing record can carry id, query, reference, answer, level, steps, and credits (official repository: dataset/*_dataset.py).

Construction. The preprocessing script asks an LLM for two to five ordered sub-questions with hints, explicitly asking it not to reveal an internal chain of thought. It then asks an LLM for JSON difficulty assessments and integer credits that sum to 100 (dataset/break_down_question.py). The paper reports LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct as the default planner, but the release does not pin the exact endpoint/model that generated each distributed decomposition.

Allocation and inference. The planned-local-weighted implementation normalizes credits, multiplies them by constant/linear/polynomial/exponential/cosine schedule weights, floors the resulting shares of the level budget, and assigns any remainder to the largest weighted shares. The level-to-budget table is 1→200, 2→250, 3→350, 4→450, and 5→600. It embeds each sub-question and a requested word limit in one prompt to the target model; this is prompt guidance, not a hard per-subquestion token cap (inference/_5_planned_local_weighted_model.py). The repository supports DeepSeek-R1 distills, QwQ-32B, s1.1-32B, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, o3-mini, and o4-mini interfaces, while the paper's reported comparison matrix is narrower.

Evaluation/output. Each local run emits prediction, prompt/completion/total tokens, score, and explanation per item, then aggregates score and completion tokens (run/run_inf.py). MATH uses math_verify; NaturalInstructions computes ROUGE-L; TravelPlanner uses secondary-LLM JSON reconstruction followed by its evaluator. The paper reports five-run means and standard deviations, allocation schedules, and an 8,192-token hard cutoff. It does not publish executed result files, full prompt/model configurations, retries, or a selected/rejected rollout ledger.

输入。 发布代码加载 MATH-500、本地抽样的 NaturalInstructions JSON 和 TravelPlanner validation 项；TravelPlanner 还携带 reference information，并需要另行下载数据库。预处理记录可含 id、query、reference、answer、level、steps 和 credits（官方仓库 dataset/*_dataset.py）。

构造。 预处理脚本先要求 LLM 生成 2 至 5 个有序子问题及 hints，并明确要求不要泄露内部 chain of thought；随后要求 LLM 返回 JSON 难度判断及总和为 100 的整数 credits（dataset/break_down_question.py）。论文报告默认 planner 为 LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct，但发布物没有固定生成每个已分解文件时使用的确切 endpoint/model。

分配与推理。 planned-local-weighted 实现先归一化 credits，再与 constant/linear/polynomial/exponential/cosine 调度权重相乘，将 level budget 的份额向下取整，并把余数给最大加权份额。level-to-budget 表为 1→200、2→250、3→350、4→450、5→600。它把每个子问题和请求的 word limit 放进对目标模型的同一个 prompt；这只是提示引导，不是严格的每子问题 token 上限（inference/_5_planned_local_weighted_model.py）。仓库支持 DeepSeek-R1 distills、QwQ-32B、s1.1-32B、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、o3-mini 与 o4-mini 接口，而论文的报告比较矩阵较窄。

评测/输出。 每次本地运行写出每项的 prediction、prompt/completion/total tokens、score 和 explanation，随后汇总 score 与 completion tokens（run/run_inf.py）。MATH 使用 math_verify；NaturalInstructions 计算 ROUGE-L；TravelPlanner 先以第二个 LLM 重建 JSON，再调用其 evaluator。论文报告了五次运行的均值和标准差、分配调度以及 8,192-token 硬上限；但没有发布实际结果文件、完整 prompt/model 配置、重试记录或选中/拒绝 rollout 台账。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The final paper is published at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview record) and arXiv v3 is dated 2 March 2026. The linked author repository is public and MIT licensed; it contains preprocessing, inference, task-evaluation code, pre-decomposed input directories, and commands for reproduction. At verification time, no tagged release or author-run results package was observed.

The authors report, over five runs, that Plan-and-Budget outperforms Vanilla and Global Budget in E3 across their reported task/model comparisons, with a maximum reported E3 improvement of 193.8% (paper §5.2). For a concrete MATH-500 comparison in the paper, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B under Global Budget obtains E3 4.55 and Plan-and-Budget obtains 5.89 (+29.4%); o4-mini changes from 13.25 to 15.95 (+20.3%). These are author-reported aggregate results, not independent replications and not measurements of data quality.

The evidence supports method availability and the stated evaluation protocol. It does not support claims that the planning credits are calibrated, that process guidance is faithful, that benchmark items are uncontaminated, or that released pre-decompositions are suitable for training.

最终论文发表于 ICLR 2026（OpenReview 记录），arXiv v3 的日期为 2026 年 3 月 2 日。链接的作者仓库公开且使用 MIT license；其中含预处理、推理、任务评测代码、预分解输入目录及复现实验命令。截至核验时，未观察到 tagged release 或作者运行得到的结果包。

作者报告，在五次运行中，Plan-and-Budget 在其所报告的任务/模型比较里，E3 均优于 Vanilla 和 Global Budget，最大报告的 E3 提升为 193.8%（论文第 5.2 节）。论文给出的一个 MATH-500 具体比较是：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 的 Global Budget E3 为 4.55，Plan-and-Budget 为 5.89（+29.4%）；o4-mini 从 13.25 变为 15.95（+20.3%）。这些是作者报告的聚合结果，不是独立复现，也不是数据质量的度量。

证据支持方法可得性及所述评测协议；它不支持 credits 已校准、过程引导忠实、benchmark 项无污染、或发布的预分解数据适合训练等主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior fixed-budget work makes one global length decision, while planning-only baselines expose a decomposition without allocating local shares. Plan-and-Budget combines those components: it turns model-generated sub-question credits into a schedule-conditioned allocation and evaluates the resulting episode with task score and total completion-token cost.

The practical novelty is therefore an allocation interface—steps, credits, level budget, schedule, and token accounting—not a new verifier, a process-supervision dataset, or an RL objective. The repository makes the interface inspectable enough to replay the algorithm, including its floor-and-remainder allocation rule. What remains non-novel or inherited is the upstream benchmark data, task metrics, LLM prompting, and external-model service.

For reasoning-data research, this is a direction signal because it forces attribution questions: changes in E3 can arise from planning, credit estimates, scheduling, model/provider behavior, task scorer, or total compute. Reuse should first check the distributed decomposition provenance, split/version alignment, and whether a proposed deployment needs hard rather than prompt-level budget enforcement.

已有 fixed-budget 工作对整题只作一次全局长度决策，而仅规划的 baseline 虽公开分解，却不分配局部份额。Plan-and-Budget 把这两个部分结合：将模型生成的子问题 credits 转换为受调度规则约束的分配，并用任务分数和总 completion-token 成本评测所得 episode。

因此，实用的新意是一个分配接口——steps、credits、level budget、schedule 和 token accounting——而不是新的 verifier、过程监督数据集或 RL 目标。仓库使该接口足够可检查，可重放其向下取整再分配余数的规则。并不新、或继承自既有工作的部分包括上游 benchmark 数据、任务指标、LLM prompting 和外部模型服务。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，它是一个方向信号，因为它迫使读者追问归因：E3 的变化可能来自规划、credit 估计、调度、模型/provider 行为、任务 scorer 或总计算量。复用前应先核查已分解数据的来源、split/version 对齐，以及拟部署场景是否需要硬预算而不是 prompt-level 预算约束。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The sub-question plan, levels, and credits are LLM-generated. A plausible decomposition can omit a dependency, and inaccurate credits can systematically misallocate compute; the paper does not release calibration or error labels for these annotations.
  • In the checked weighted implementation, local limits are natural-language instructions expressed in words. The API call can still generate up to its overall maximum, so the implementation does not demonstrate strict isolation of token use per sub-question.
  • E3 depends on heterogeneous task scores and average billed completion tokens. Squaring A makes score differences influential, while provider tokenization, reasoning-token reporting, and planning-token accounting can change T. It is a comparison metric, not proof of a better trace or data record.
  • TravelPlanner needs a secondary LLM to reconstruct JSON before scoring. Its model/version is supplied through the environment rather than pinned by the release, creating judge/conversion drift and potential false failures or passes.
  • The repository ships code and pre-decomposed inputs but not its executed predictions, scores, seeds, endpoint/model revisions, complete prompts, failed calls, or decontamination analysis. Curator inference: absent those artifacts, performance attribution and audit replay remain limited even when the source code runs.

• 子问题计划、levels 和 credits 由 LLM 生成。看似合理的分解可能漏掉依赖，不准确的 credits 可能系统性地错配计算；论文没有发布这些标注的校准或错误标签。
  • 在所检查的 weighted 实现中，局部限制是以 words 表达的自然语言指令。API 调用仍可生成至其总体最大值，因此该实现没有证明每个子问题的 token 使用被严格隔离。
  • E3 依赖异质的任务分数与平均计费 completion tokens。A 的平方使分数差异影响很大，而 provider tokenization、reasoning-token 报告和 planning-token 计入方式均可改变 T。它是比较指标，不是更好轨迹或数据记录的证据。
  • TravelPlanner 在评分前需要第二个 LLM 重建 JSON。其 model/version 通过环境提供，而非由发布物固定，这会带来 judge/conversion drift，以及 false failure 或 false pass 的可能。
  • 仓库发布了代码和预分解输入，但未发布实际 predictions、scores、seeds、endpoint/model revisions、完整 prompts、失败调用或去污染分析。curator inference：缺少这些 artifact 时，即使源码能运行，性能归因和审计重放仍受限。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Reuse class: evaluation/inference recipe and audit reference; not cleared for training-data reuse. Builders can use the repository to compare a fixed global cap, planning-only prompt, uniform allocation, and credit-weighted schedules under matched task/model conditions. Record planning tokens, target-model tokens, endpoint/model revision, schedule, and per-item score rather than only E3.

For the assigned rollout/search/test-time-trace track, the useful unit is the episode schema: retain original item identifier and version, decomposition prompt/output, credits, level budget, actual API usage, final prediction, evaluator version/output, and failures. This converts an allocation claim into an auditable trace record and makes it possible to separate planner effects from budget effects.

For evaluation design, MATH's programmatic answer check is more reproducible than TravelPlanner's LLM JSON conversion, but neither establishes safe reward use without false-positive/negative testing. For production use, implement an actual token-enforcement mechanism if needed, test schedule sensitivity and credit calibration, and keep benchmark prompts separate from any subsequent training mixture.

复用等级：评测/推理 recipe 与审计参考；未获准作训练数据复用。 构建者可用该仓库在匹配的任务/模型条件下比较固定 global cap、仅规划 prompt、均匀分配和 credit-weighted schedule。应记录 planning tokens、目标模型 tokens、endpoint/model revision、schedule 和逐项分数，而不只记录 E3。

对分配的 rollout/search/test-time-trace 赛道而言，有用的单位是 episode schema：保留原始项标识与版本、分解 prompt/output、credits、level budget、实际 API usage、最终 prediction、evaluator version/output 以及 failures。这样能把分配主张变成可审计轨迹记录，也能分离 planner effect 和 budget effect。

对评测设计而言，MATH 的程序化答案检查比 TravelPlanner 的 LLM JSON 转换更可复现，但二者都不能在未测试 false positive/negative 的情况下证明适合奖励使用。生产使用若需要，应实施真正的 token-enforcement mechanism，测试 schedule sensitivity 和 credit calibration，并把 benchmark prompts 与之后的训练混合物分开。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read paper §§3–4 with dataset/break_down_question.py and inference/_5_planned_local_weighted_model.py: the released mechanism is prompt decomposition plus credit/schedule allocation, not execution of independently checked sub-solves.
  • Read paper §5 with run/run_inf.py: E3 uses aggregate task score and completion-token usage. Check exactly which tokens, model API, and task scorer enter each comparison.
  • Treat the pre-decomposed input files as evaluation scaffolding whose generation provenance is incomplete, not as a vetted training corpus.
  • Inspect dataset/travelplanner_dataset.py before interpreting TravelPlanner results: a secondary LLM performs JSON reconstruction before the evaluator.
  • Read alongside fixed-budget and test-time-compute work, but require per-item trace manifests and contamination controls before making data-quality or causal-attribution claims.

• 将论文第 3–4 节与 dataset/break_down_question.py、inference/_5_planned_local_weighted_model.py 一起读：发布的机制是 prompt 分解加 credit/schedule 分配，不是对各子解独立执行并检查。
  • 将论文第 5 节与 run/run_inf.py 一起读：E3 使用聚合的任务分数与 completion-token 用量。应核查每个比较究竟计入哪些 tokens、模型 API 和任务 scorer。
  • 将预分解输入文件视为生成来源不完整的评测 scaffolding，而不是已经审查过的训练语料。
  • 解读 TravelPlanner 结果前先检查 dataset/travelplanner_dataset.py：evaluator 之前有第二个 LLM 执行 JSON 重建。
  • 可与 fixed-budget 和 test-time-compute 工作一同阅读，但在提出数据质量或因果归因主张前，仍应要求逐项 trace manifest 和污染控制。

title: Citation
引用
html:

Official paper records: OpenReview and arXiv:2505.16122 (v3, 2 March 2026). The official author repository is junhongmit/P-and-B, which provides its ICLR BibTeX entry and is MIT licensed. No separate official dataset release, project page, or model release was verified; the repository's pre-decomposed evaluation files must not be represented as a separately released training dataset.

value.html: The released repository evaluates MATH-500, a sampled 500-item NaturalInstructions set, and TravelPlanner; it includes pre-decomposed JSON files for those evaluation inputs, while TravelPlanner additionally requires its database download.

A released preprocessed item can contain id, query, reference when applicable, steps, credits, answer, and level. A run writes id, query, answer, prediction, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, score, and explanation; these result files are generated locally rather than supplied as a checked author result manifest.

An external LLM/API produces the decomposition and credit annotations during preprocessing; a selected reasoning model produces the final prediction at test time. The repository's environment template leaves API_BASE and MODEL_NAME blank, so the exact serving endpoint and several run-specific models are not fixed by the release.

Training-free Python inference/evaluation code using an OpenAI-compatible API or local vLLM. The repository documents Python 3.12, vLLM installation, asynchronous workers, and a configurable endpoint; hardware, API provider, model revisions, seeds, and executed-result logs are not released as a pinned experiment package.

There is no training reward. MATH-500 is checked with math_verify after answer extraction; NaturalInstructions uses ROUGE-L against the reference; TravelPlanner converts text to JSON with a secondary LLM and then calls the TravelPlanner evaluator. E3 is a reported aggregate metric, E3 = A^2 / T, where A is task score and T is average billed completion tokens, not a per-step verifier.

For a single evaluation record, the task-specific evaluator returns score (and sometimes an explanation); the paper aggregates score and completion-token count across a dataset. TravelPlanner's LLM-based JSON conversion makes its terminal scoring partly model-dependent.

Experiments cover DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, and o4-mini; the repository also lists simplescaling/s1.1-32B as a supported completion model. Exact model revisions and endpoint implementations are not disclosed in a run manifest.

LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct is the reported/default planner in the paper; the code's preprocessing calls the endpoint named by MODEL_NAME, and a planner-sensitivity appendix replaces the default planner with LLaMA-3.3-70B. The exact model used to create every distributed decomposition file is not separately versioned.

The preprocessing script prompts an LLM to produce an ordered list of two to five sub-questions with hints, then prompts it for JSON difficulty assessments and integer credits that sum to 100. The planned-local-weighted inference code multiplies normalized credits by a schedule weight and allocates the total budget by flooring then distributing the remainder.

The paper reports means and standard deviations over five runs, a hard 8,192-token cutoff, and uniform, weighted, linear, polynomial, exponential, and cosine allocation schedules. The checked repository defaults ordinary chat/completion calls to temperature 0.1 and top_p 0.9, but it does not pin all API/model settings for the published experiments.
Five runs are reported for the comparative experiments; the number of sampled candidate solutions per evaluation item is not disclosed as a separate rollout count.
0.1 is the repository default for ordinary chat/completion calls; experiment-specific decoding settings, including reasoning-model settings, are not fully pinned.

This is an evaluation/inference framework, not a training-data construction pipeline. The checked repository exposes no selected-versus-rejected rollout ledger, deduplication rule, or training-data filter.

The code maps levels 1–5 to 200, 250, 350, 450, and 600 units respectively before local allocation, while the paper also applies a hard 8,192-token generation cutoff. E3 counts billed completion tokens including planning, reasoning, and output tokens; a complete per-item budget and token ledger is not released.
No post-training optimizer is used. The scaffold is a planning prompt, a local scheduling rule, task-specific scoring, and aggregate E3 reporting.

MATH-500 is loaded from HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500; TravelPlanner is loaded from osunlp/TravelPlanner validation and the repository requests an additional database download; the sampled NaturalInstructions input is bundled as a local JSON file. Exact source versions, sampling seed, and item manifests are not consolidated in the release.

The paper evaluates 500 MATH-500 items, 500 sampled NaturalInstructions items, and 180 TravelPlanner QA pairs. The code reads the MATH test split and TravelPlanner validation split, but a versioned mapping from every reported run to every input record is unavailable.
unknown

items: Complexity levels and sub-question credits are model-generated annotations; errors can send too little budget to a difficult part or too much to an easy part.
The scheduler constrains text with prompts such as a word limit; it is not a hard per-subquestion token enforcement mechanism in the checked inference code.
E3 squares a task score and divides by average tokens, so rankings depend on task metric choice, token accounting, and API/model behavior rather than establishing data quality.
TravelPlanner uses a secondary LLM to reconstruct JSON before programmatic scoring; conversion errors, model changes, and prompt sensitivity can alter scores.
